fever.description: Elevation in body temperature above normal range (≥ 38°C or 100.4°F).

cough.description: Sudden, repetitive reflex to clear the breathing passages of secretions or irritants.

headache.description: Pain or aching sensation anywhere in the region of the head or neck.

fatigue.description: Overall feeling of tiredness, lack of energy, or physical weakness.

chest_pain.description: Discomfort or pain felt anywhere along the front of your body between neck and upper abdomen.

shortness_of_breath.description: Uncomfortable or intense sensation of difficulty breathing or inability to catch breath.

abdominal_pain.description: Pain or discomfort occurring in the area between chest and pelvis.

sore_throat.description: Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat that often worsens when swallowing.

joint_pain.description: Discomfort, pain, or inflammation arising from any joint.

nausea.description: Sensation of unease and discomfort in stomach with an urge to vomit.

vomiting.description: Involuntary, forceful ejection of stomach contents through the mouth.

diarrhea.description: Condition of having three or more loose, liquid, or watery bowel movements per day.

dizziness.description: Sensation of lightheadedness, unsteadiness, or feeling that surroundings are spinning.

runny_nose.description: Excess nasal discharge or congestion in nostrils.

muscle_aches.description: Pain or discomfort affecting muscles throughout the body.

loss_of_taste_or_smell.description: Partial or complete loss of sense of smell or taste.

chills.description: Feeling of coldness accompanied by involuntary shivering.

skin_rash.description: Noticeable change in texture or color of skin, often accompanied by itching or inflammation.

sweating.description: Excretion of fluid by sweat glands, often excessive during fever or cardiac distress.

back_pain.description: Pain originating in spine, muscles, or nerves of the back.

high_blood_pressure.description: Abnormally high pressure of blood against arterial walls.

frequent_urination.description: Need to urinate more often than usual.

painful_urination.description: Discomfort, pain, or burning sensation during urination.

excessive_thirst.description: Abnormal or constant feeling of needing to drink fluids.

stiff_neck.description: Soreness and difficulty moving or bending the neck.

confusion.description: Inability to think as clearly or quickly as usual, or feeling disoriented.

light_sensitivity.description: Intolerance or discomfort caused by light exposure.

ear_pain.description: Pain or discomfort inside or around the ear canal.

tinnitus.description: Perception of noise or ringing in ears without external sound.

swollen_ankle.description: Accumulation of fluid causing swelling in feet, ankles, or legs.

eye_redness.description: Red or bloodshot appearance of sclera due to swollen blood vessels.

tremor.description: Involuntary, rhythmic muscle contraction leading to shaking movements.

muscle_stiffness.description: Inability of muscles to relax normally, causing tightness or stiffness.

slowed_movement.description: Slowness of movement, characteristic of neurological condition like Parkinsonism.

increased_hunger.description: Excessive or unquenchable hunger and appetite.
